motion.title: Motion Lab
motion.subtitle: Film a set. See how you move and how the machine works.
motion.cardHint: Film your execution or analyse a machine
motion.unavailable: Video analysis works on iPhone only for now, in the installed app (not in Expo Go).
motion.executionMessage: Film a set and see each rep: range, tempo, speed and how closely you follow the same path.
motion.machineMessage: Film a few reps and get the machine's resistance profile, and whether it suits the muscle it's meant to train.
motion.savedEmpty: Your analysed sets and machines appear here.
motion.executionIntro: Film one set from the side. Then tap the handle or bar on the first frame: SpotMe follows it and your joints through the video.
motion.machineIntro: Film 2–3 slow reps with a light weight, with the handle and the weight stack (or the plates) both in the picture. SpotMe compares how far the load rises with how far the handle moves at each point: that's the machine's leverage, the shape of its resistance. No force is measured.
motion.startsWithLoweringHint: Squat, bench press: you go down first, then lift.
motion.tipSide: Film from the side, square to the movement.
motion.tipSteady: Keep the phone still: lean it on something or use a tripod.
motion.tipBody: Keep your whole body and the whole movement in the picture.
motion.tipMachine: Keep the handle and the weight stack (or plates) in the picture the whole time.
motion.tipRest: Start recording with the weight at rest.
motion.cameraMessage: SpotMe needs the camera to record the exercise. No sound is recorded, and the video is analysed on your phone and not stored.
motion.recordHint: Tap to start, then do your reps
motion.stopHint: Tap to stop when you're done
motion.markSubtitle: Tap each point on the picture
motion.markImageLabel: First frame of the video. Tap to place the selected point.
motion.markerHandleHint: Tap the handle, bar or pad you push: a spot with contrast, like the end of a grip.
motion.markerLoadHint: Tap the top plate of the weight stack, or the plates on a plate-loaded arm.
motion.markerPivotHint: Tap the bolt the machine's arm rotates around. Optional: it adds the lever lines and the arm's angle.
motion.working: Following the points through the video…

error.unavailable: Video analysis isn't available in this build.
error.noReps: No full rep found. Make sure the marked points move through the whole rep and stay in the picture, then try again.
error.failed: The video couldn't be analysed. Try another one.

motion.chartLabel: Resistance over the range of motion
motion.verdictExplain: This machine's resistance is {{shape}}. For this movement a {{ideal}} curve is ideal: heavy where you're strong, lighter where you're weak.
motion.verdictNoCurve: This machine's resistance is {{shape}}. Pick a movement to compare it with a strength curve.

notes.heavyWhenStretched: It stays heavy where the muscle is stretched, the part of the rep most linked to muscle growth.
notes.lightWhenStretched: It's light where the muscle is stretched, so the start of each rep does little work.
notes.fadesAtEnd: Resistance fades towards the end: the last part of each rep is easy.
notes.heaviestAtEnd: It's heaviest right at the end, where the muscle is shortest.
notes.peaksEarly: It peaks earlier in the rep than your strength does.
notes.peaksLate: It peaks later in the rep than your strength does.
notes.even: Resistance is nearly the same through the whole range.

motion.profileSubtitle: How heavy it feels at each point, against its own peak

confidence.high: Reliable reading: the lifts agree and the points were tracked well.
confidence.medium: Fair reading: film again, steadier and squarer, for a cleaner curve.
confidence.low: Rough reading: the lifts disagree or the points were lost at times. Film again from the side with the phone still.

motion.machineDisclaimer: The strength curves are textbook shapes, not measured on you: use the fit as a guide.
motion.allClean: Every rep had full range, stayed on the path and was controlled.
motion.jointSubtitle: The joint that moved most, from the side

flags.shortRange: Cut short: less range than your best rep.
flags.rushedReturn: Lowered too fast: control the way down.

motion.lowTracking: The handle was lost in part of the video, so these numbers are rough. Mark a spot with more contrast and keep it in the picture.
motion.notFound: This analysis is no longer here.

fatigue.title: Muscle fatigue
fatigue.subtitle: Estimated from your logged sets: how much of each muscle's recent work it hasn't recovered from yet.
fatigue.emptyHint: Log a workout and the muscles you trained show up here with how long they need to recover.
